Please compare and contrast two people you know, focusing on key attributes, values, and beliefs. Provide specific examples to support your conclusions.

Second，你将研究其中的关键点，每个人应该从简单的事实和特质到价值和个人信念的特征，他们承认的。同时，也要考虑诱发项，原因小组可能的生活和观念中的不同的渴望和价值观
Third，根据你来说人们对这个关键点的看法，你是既有偏见的或公平的。请记录为什么，你对这个的分析。
第四，列出对你来说不同于这两个人中其他人的角色或者是一个人比他们其他人的优势的特质。
第五，对于你对这两个人的看法，你开发了一个简短的论证标题，包括表示这个伙伴并支持你的论点的结论.
Please conduct a reflective study of your perception of two caregivers you know (i.e. one who behaves ethically, and another who does not). Describe the caregiving process for both individuals and link it to the two different levels of care described in this course (Know Your Child, Know Your Parent). Your report should include an introduction, outlining issues and a clear research question, a review of literature and analysis, and a conclusion. There should be approximately five pages of text.
